$comment: VENDORED copy of the normative kiosk.tech schema at spec/schemas/mandates.schema.json. It is here so RequestValidation can hold a reserved-plane request body to it at runtime, and so e2e/schema_conformance.rb can validate this origin's LIVE wire bytes against the PUBLISHED schema -- both with no second checkout and no network fetch. Identical to the upstream copy as PARSED JSON once this $comment is removed.
title: Kiosk AP2 payment mandates
description: The decoded JWS payloads of the three AP2 mandates and the POST /kiosk/pay request body. On the wire each mandate is an RS256 compact JWS string; these schemas describe the decoded claim sets.

iss.description: MUST equal the provider issuer from /.well-known/kiosk.json, verbatim.

exp.description: An exp already in the past is rejected.

cap_amount_cents.description: Spending cap; there is no "no cap" spelling -- a nil cap is rejected. MUST be positive; a non-positive amount is rejected.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 ALPHA-3 code, and the `pattern` is the domain: three ASCII letters, either case. An operator MAY refuse more (Section 11.1).

intent_mandate_id.description: MUST equal the intent mandate id; cart total MUST NOT exceed the intent cap.

total_amount_cents.description: MUST be positive; a non-positive amount is rejected.

currency.description: MUST equal the intent currency, and MUST be an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code -- see the intent's note; equality to another empty string, or to another currency NAME, is not a check.

line_items.description: Provider-defined line items, at least one. The operator matches a settlement to its own record through them.

cart_mandate_id.description: MUST equal the cart mandate id.

amount_cents.description: MUST equal the cart total, same currency. MUST be positive; a non-positive amount is rejected.

currency.description: MUST equal the cart currency, and MUST be an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code.

payRequest.description: The POST /kiosk/pay request body: the three mandates as compact JWS strings.

settlement.description: The pay response body, answered verbatim: there is no envelope, no ok flag and no kind discriminator (protocol.md 8.2, 11.3).

settled_amount_cents.description: The captured amount; equals the cart total. MUST be positive: a settlement exists only for a completed capture, and every mandate amount is already positive.

currency.description: The currency of the capture: the cart's currency in the OPERATOR's canonical spelling, which MAY differ byte for byte from the spelling the assistant signed (protocol.md 11.3, 11.5). Compare it as an ISO 4217 code, never as bytes.
